title: Reject stale tool evidence before external decisions
narrative: Tool results that drive external decisions carry source and freshness metadata. An eight-day-old CRM cache must not be silently treated as current: expired or too-old results are rejected as errors before the decision. Context freshness scoring in `fangore_jev_context_picker` and `fangore_insp_context_provider` covers retrieved context; this story covers typed tool-result TTL. Tracks personal-agent inspiration MH-PA-01[^insp-pa-01].
implementation: `ToolResult` gains optional `source`, `observed_at`, `fetched_at`, and `expires_at`. `ToolResultFreshnessPolicy` (and module helpers `is_stale` / `reject_if_stale`) returns an error copy `stale_tool_result:<reason>:source=<source>` for expired results, results older than `max_age_seconds`, or (optionally) results without a `source`. Wiring the reject into a graph decision node is a host choice of where to call the policy.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/tool_result_freshness_reject.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
